title: Platinum Ore Ultra
description: Sets generation of platinum ore (Create Propulsion) to the maximum.
body:
# Platinum Ore Ultra

Sets the generation of platinum ore (Create Propulsion) to the maximum value to work with the ore plus ultra datapack. 

## Requirements

This datapack needs the datapack [Ore Plus Ultra](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ore_plus_ultra) and the mods [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [Create Propulsion: Simulated](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-propulsion-simulated) to work.
